recipes.name: Charlie Brown Thanksgiving
ingredients: 1 cup turkey stock, divided into 1/4 cup and 2/3 of a cup
6 1/4 oz all purpose flour, plus more for dusting
pie weight (I went with brown rice)
instructions: For Turkey:

First, loosen the skin from the turkey. Combine the kosher salt with black pepper. Rub about ¾ of that mixture under the skin. Then add the baking powder to the salt and pepper mixture and cover the outside of the turkey. - 1 whole turkey - ¼ cup kosher salt - 1 tbsp back pepper - 1 ½ tsp baking powder
Once fully coated, let it rest uncovered in the fridge for 24 hours. - 1 whole turkey
Line the inside of the turkey with a few layers of cheesecloth. Add your stuffing (recipe below) and then tie the cheesecloth shut. Also tie the legs. - 1 whole turkey - Stuffing (see below)
Roll 4 large cylinders of aluminum foil. Place three of them widthwise and 1 lengthwise onto your pan - this will hold the turkey up.

Place the turkey breast-side down onto the cylinders and top the turkey with bacon. Cook in a preheated 325°F oven. When the turkey has reached 130°F, remove from the oven. - 1 whole turkey - 1 pack of bacon
Remove bacon from the turkey. - 1 pack of bacon - 1 whole turkey

While the turkey cooks, chop up your turnips, parsnips, and carrots and add them to a bowl along with your red pearl onions. Season with salt and pepper and top with vegetable oil. Toss to combine. - 1 whole turkey - 1 turnip - 3 parsnips - 6 large carrots - 1 ½ cups pearl red onions - vegetable oil as needed - ¼ cup kosher salt - 1 tbsp back pepper
On a rimmed baking sheet add your turnip, parsnip, carrot and onion mixture and place a wire rack on top. - 1 turnip - 3 parsnips - 6 large carrots - 1 ½ cups pearl red onions
The turkey should already be cooked to 130°F. Flip the turkey so it’s breast-side up and place on the wire rack on top of the vegetable mixture. - 1 whole turkey
Remove stuffing from the turkey and then brush down the turkey with clarified butter. - Stuffing (see below) - 1 whole turkey - clarified butter as needed
Place back in the oven, and increase the temperature to 400°F and cook for an additional 45 minutes, or until the thickest part of the breast registers 160°F. - 1 whole turkey
Remove from the oven and let the turkey rest for 30 minutes. - 1 whole turkey
Strain any juice in the baking sheet to help make gravy.
Place the tray of veggies back in the oven for 20 minutes.
Carve the turkey and serve with everything else and enjoy!
For Stuffing:
Dice white sandwich bread. Cook in a 225°F oven for one hour, stirring occasionally. - ¾ loaf white bread

In a high-walled sauté pan add: Spanish onion (finely chopped) along with chopped ribs of celery. Cook for about 2 minutes before adding sage, thyme, and rosemary. Cook for 2 more minutes. - 1 spanish onion finely chopped - 2 ribs of celery chopped - 1 tbsp sage - 1 tsp thyme - 1 tsp rosemary

In a large bowl add your toasted bread along with your onion celery mixture plus parsley and turkey stock. Mix to combine and season with salt and pepper. - ¾ loaf white bread - 1 spanish onion finely chopped - 2 ribs of celery chopped - 1 tbsp sage - 1 tsp thyme - 1 tsp rosemary - 1 tbsp parsley - 1 cup turkey stock divided into 1/4 cup and 2/3 of a cup - salt to taste - pepper to taste
Insert cheesecloth into the cavity of the turkey and then add as much stuffing as you can fit. (It should not all fit) - turkey

Remove stuffing when the turkey has reached 130°F and combine with the reserved stuffing. In a mixing bowl combine the egg with turkey stock and beat to combine before adding to the stuffing mixture. Stir to combine. - 1 egg beaten - 1 cup turkey stock divided into 1/4 cup and 2/3 of a cup
Butter a casserole dish and then add stuffing evenly. - 3 tbsp unsalted butter
Once the turkey is removed from the oven, place the stuffing in the oven and cook for about 20 minutes.
For Pumpkin Pie:
For the Crust

In a food processor combine all purpose flour along with cold unsalted butter, salt, and sugar. Process to combine. - 6 oz all purpose flour plus more for dusting - 10 tbsp unsalted butter cold - ½ tsp salt - 1 tbsp sugar
Add the mixture to a bowl along with ice water. Gently fold to combine. - 3 ½ tbsp ice water

Flour your work surface and turn out dough. It will be sticky - just make it into a cohesive mass and cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 30 minutes. - 6 oz all purpose flour plus more for dusting - For The Pie Crust

Flour your work surface and your rolling pin and roll out your dough until it is 2 inches wider than the pie pan. Drape the crust into a pie pan. Trim the edges and pinch any holes. Refrigerate for 15 minutes. - 6 oz all purpose flour plus more for dusting - For The Pie Crust

Poke a bunch of holes in the bottom of the crust using a fork. Then press down a layer of aluminum foil onto the pie crust and fill with your desired pie weight (I used brown rice, you can also use dried beans). - For The Pie Crust - pie weight (I went with brown rice)
Par bake crust for 15 minutes at 400°F on a preheated pizza stone in the oven. - For The Pie Crust
For the Pie Filling
Slice open a sugar pie pumpkin. Scoop out the insides and place face-down on a parchment-lined baking sheet and roast at 325°F for one hour. - 1 sugar pie pumpkin
Remove from the oven and peel the skin off. Let cool for 2 minutes. - 1 sugar pie pumpkin
Add pumpkin to a food processor along with packed brown sugar and maple syrup. Process for about 90 seconds or until smooth. - 1 sugar pie pumpkin - 1 cup packed brown sugar - 1 ½ tbsp maple syrup

Next add cinnamon, ground ginger, allspice and ground cloves, a generous grating of nutmeg, milk, heavy cream, and eggs. Process for 1 minute or until smooth. - 2 tsp cinnamon - 2 tsp ground ginger - ¼ tsp allspice - ¼ tsp ground cloves - grated nutmeg - ½ cup milk - ¾ cup heavy cream - 4 eggs
For the Whipped Cream
Combine heavy cream with sugar. - 2 tbsp sugar - 1 cup heavy whipping cream - vanilla extract (optional)
Whisk to combine (or use a hand mixer). - For The Whipped Cream
For the Pie Assembly
Add filling to par baked pie crust and bake for 25 minutes or until the crust is brown. - For The Pie Filling - For The Pie Crust
Top with whipped cream (recipe above). - For The Whipped Cream
Serve and enjoy.
